MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WITH t, c, collect(o.name) AS owners
WHERE CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) > 1989 AND NOT ('Gabe Plotkin and Rick Schnall' IN owners)
RETURN c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
UNION
MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WHERE o.name = 'Atlanta Spirit LLC' AND CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) = 1967
RETURN c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
